description.value: The South Peace Community Multiplex is a municipal sports and recreation centre operated by the City of Dawson Creek in Northern BC. It serves as a community hub for athletics and leisure activities in the Peace River region. Touring cyclists passing through Dawson Creek — a key stop on routes through northeastern BC — may find it a useful rest point, though specific amenities could not be verified.
